## tal-a17-p03

source_text: [and]-tasyaiva tatsvatantratvaṃ yātidurghaṭakāritā / saṃbodharūpe tattasmin kathaṃ saṃbodhanā bhavet prakāśanāyāṃ na syātprakāśasya prakāśatā / saṃbodhanavibhaktyaiva vinā karmādiśaktitām svātantryāttaṃ darśayituṃ tatrohamimamācaret / devamāvāhayāmīti tato devāya dīpakam prāgyuktyā pūrṇatādāyi namaḥsvāhādikaṃ bhavet / nutiḥ pūrṇatvamagnīndusaṃghaṭṭāpyāyatā param āpyāyakaṃ ca procchālaṃ vauṣaḍādi pradīpayet / tatra bāhye@pi tādātmyaprasiddhaṃ karma codyate yadi karmapadaṃ tanno gururabhyūhayetkvacit / anābhāsitatadvastubhāsanāya niyujyate mantraḥ kiṃ tena tatra syātsphuṭaṃ yatrāvabhāsi tat / tena prokṣaṇasaṃsekajapādividhiṣu dhruvam tatkarmābhyūhanaṃ kuryātpratyuta vyavadhātṛtām / bahistathātmatābhāve kāryaṃ karmapadohanam tṛptāvāhutihutabhukpāśaploṣacchidādiṣu / yatroddiṣṭe vidhau paścāttadanantaiḥ kriyātmakaiḥ aṃśaiḥ sādhyaṃ na tatroho dīkṣaṇādividhiṣviva / tataḥ śiṣyasya tattattvasthāne@streṇa pratāḍanam

## tal-a17-p04

source_text: [and]-kṛtvātha śivahastena hṛdayaṃ parimarśayet / tataḥ svanāḍīmārgeṇa hṛdayaṃ prāpya vai śiśoḥ śiṣyātmanā sahaikatvaṃ gatvādāya ca taṃ hṛdā / puṭitaṃ haṃsarūpākhyaṃ tatra saṃhāramudrayā kuryādātmīyahṛdayasthitamapyavabhāsakam / śiṣyadehasya tejobhī raśmimātrāviyogataḥ svabandhasthānacalanāt svatantrasthānalābhataḥ / svakarmāparatantratvātsarvatrotpattimarhati tenātmahṛdayānītaṃ prākkṛtvā pudgalaṃ tataḥ / māyāyāṃ taddharātattvaśarīrāṇyasya saṃsṛjet tatrāsya garbhādhānaṃ ca yuktaṃ puṃsavanādibhiḥ / garbhaniṣkrāmaparyantairekāṃ kurvīta saṃskriyām jananaṃ bhogabhoktṛtvaṃ militvaikātha saṃskriyā / tato@sya teṣu bhogeṣu kuryāttanmayatāṃ layam tatastattattvapāśānāṃ vicchedaṃ samupācaret / saṃskārāṇāṃ catuṣke@sminnaparāṃ ca parāparām mantrāṇāṃ pañcadaśakaṃ parāṃ vā yojayetkramāt / pivanyādyaṣṭakaṃ śastrādikaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ parā tathā iti pañcadaśaite syuḥ kramāllīnatvasaṃskṛtau / aparāmantramuktvā prāgamukātmana ityatha

## tal-a17-p05

source_text: [and]-garbhādhānaṃ karomīti punarmantraṃ tameva ca / svāhāntamuccarandadyādāhutitritayaṃ guruḥ paraṃ parāparāmantramamukātmana ityatha / jātasya bhogabhoktṛtvaṃ karomyatha parāparām ante svāheti proccārya vitarettisra āhutīḥ / uccārya pivanīmantramamukātmana ityatha bhoge layaṃ karomīti punarmantraṃ tameva ca / svāhāntamāhutīstisro dadyādājyatilādibhiḥ eṣa eva vamanyādau vidhiḥ pañcadaśāntake / pūrvaṃ parātmakaṃ mantramamukātmana ityatha pāśācchedaṃ karomīti parāmantraḥ punastataḥ / huṃ svāhā phaṭ samuccārya dadyāttisro@pyathāhutīḥ saṃskārāṇāṃ catuṣke@sminye mantrāḥ kathitā mayā / teṣu karmapadātpūrvaṃ dharātattvapadaṃ vadet tato dharātattvapatimāmantryeṣṭvā pratarpya ca / śivābhimānasaṃrabdho gururevaṃ samādiśet tattveśvara tvayā nāsya putrakasya śivājñayā / pratibandhaḥ prakartavyo yātuḥ padamanāmayam tato yadi samīheta dharātattvāntarālagam / pṛthak śodhayituṃ mantrī bhuvanādyadhvapañcakam

## tal-a17-p06

source_text: [and]-aparāmantrataḥ prāgvattisrastisrastadāhutīḥ / dadyātpuraṃ śodhayāmītyūhayuktaṃ prasannadhīḥ evaṃ kalāmantrapadavarṇeṣvapi vicakṣaṇaḥ / tisrastisro hutīrdadyāt pṛthak sāmastyato@pivā tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā parayā vauṣaḍantayā / aparāmantrataḥ śiṣyamuddhṛtyātmahṛdaṃ nayet yadā tvekena śuddhena tadantarbhāvacintanāt / na pṛthak śodhayettattvanāthasaṃśravaṇātparam tadā pūrṇāṃ vitīryāṇumutkṣipyātmani yojayet / tātsthyātmasaṃsthyayogāya tayaivāparayāhutīḥ sakarmapadayā dadyāditi kecittu manvate / anye tu guravaḥ prāhurbhāvanāmayamīdṛśam nātra bāhyāhutirdeyā daiśikasya pṛthak punaḥ / dadyādvā yadi no doṣaḥ syādupāyaḥ sa bhāvane evaṃ prāktanatātsthyātmasaṃsthatve yojayedguruḥ / tataḥ śiṣyahṛdaṃ neyaḥ sa ātmā tāvato@dhvanaḥ śuddhastaddārḍhyasiddhyai ca pūrṇā syātparayā punaḥ / mahāpāśupataṃ pūrvaṃ vilomasya viśuddhaye juhomi punarastreṇa vauṣaḍanta iti kṣipet / punaḥ pūrṇāṃ tato māyāmabhyarcyātha visarjayet

## tal-a17-p07

source_text: [and]-dharātattvaṃ viśuddhaṃ sajjalena śuddharūpiṇā / bhāvayenmiśritaṃ vāri śuddhiyogyaṃ tato bhavet tathā tattatpurātattvamiśraṇāduttarottaram / sarvā śivībhavettattvāvalī śuddhānyathā pṛthak pṛthaktvaṃ ca malo māyābhidhānastasya saṃbhave / karmakṣaye@pi no muktirbhavedvidyeśvarādivat tato@pi jalatattvasya vahnau vyomni cidātmake / āhvānādyakhilaṃ yāvattejasyasya vimaśraṇam evaṃ kramātkalātattve śuddhe pāśaṃ bhujāśritam / chindyātkalā hi sā kiṃcitkartṛtvonmīlanātmikā karmākhyamalajṛmbhātmā taṃ ca granthiṃ srugagragam / pūrṇāhutyā samaṃ vahnimantratejasi nirdahet mantro hi viśvarūpaḥ sannupāśrayavaśāttathā / vyaktarūpastato vahnau pāśaploṣavidhāyakaḥ pluṣṭo līnasvabhāvo@sau pāśastaṃ prati śambhuvat / parameśamahātejaḥśeṣamātratvamaśnute karmapāśe@tra hotavye pūrṇayāsya śubhāśubham / aśubhaṃ vā bhavadbhūtaṃ bhāvi vātha samastakam dahāmi phaṭtrayaṃ vauṣaḍiti pūrṇāṃ vinikṣipet / evaṃ māyāntasaṃśuddhau kaṇṭhapāśaṃ ca homayet

## tal-a17-p08

source_text: [and]-pūrṇasya tasya māyākhyaṃ pāśabhedaprathātmakam / dahāmi phaṭtrayaṃ vauṣaḍiti pūrṇāṃ kṣipedguruḥ nirbījā yadi kāryā tu tadātraivāparāṃ kṣipet / pūrṇāṃ samayapāśākhyabījadāhapadānvitām gurau deve tathā śāstre bhaktiḥ kāryāsya nahyasau / samayaḥ śaktipātasya svabhāvo hyeṣa no pṛthak māyānte śuddhimāyāte vāgīśī yā purābhavat / māyā śaktimayī saiva vidyāśaktitvamaśnute tacchuddhavidyāmāhūya vidyāśaktiṃ niyojayet / evaṃ krameṇa saṃśuddhe sadāśivapade@pyalam śikhāṃ granthiyutāṃ chittvā malamāṇavakaṃ dahet / yato@dhikārabhogākhyau dvau pāśau tu sadāśive ityuktyāṇavapāśo@tra māyīyastu niśāvadhiḥ / śiṣyo yathocitaṃ snāyādācāmeddaiśikaḥ svayam āṇavākhye vinirdagdhe hyadhovāhiśikhāmale / tataḥ prāguktasakalaprameyaṃ paricintayan śiṣyadehādimātmīyadehaprāṇādiyojitam / kṛtvātmadehaprāṇāderviśvamantaranusmaret uktaprakriyayā caivaṃ dṛḍhabuddhirananyadhīḥ / prāṇasthaṃ deśakālādhvayugaṃ prāṇaṃ ca śaktigam

## tal-a17-p09

source_text: [and]-tāṃ ca saṃvidgatāṃ śuddhāṃ saṃvidaṃ śivarūpiṇīm / śiṣyasaṃvidabhinnāṃ ca mantravahnyādyabhedinīm dhyāyan prāgvatprayogeṇa śivaṃ sakalaniṣkalam / dvyātmakaṃ vā kṣipetpūrṇāṃ praśāntakaraṇena tu uktaṃ traiśirase tantre sarvasaṃpūraṇātmakam / mūlādudayagatyā tu śivenduparisaṃplutam janmāntamadhyakuharamūlasrotaḥsamutthitam / śivārkaraśmibhistīvraiḥ kṣubdhaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ tu yat tena saṃtarpayetsamyak praśāntakaraṇena tu / śūnyadhāmābjamadhyasthaprabhākiraṇabhāsvaraḥ ādheyādhāraniḥspandabodhaśāstraparigrahaḥ / janmādheyaprapañcaikasphoṭasaṃghaṭṭaghaṭṭanaḥ mūlasthānātsamārabhya kṛtvā someśamantagam / khamivātiṣṭhate yāvatpraśāntaṃ tāvaducyate uktaṃ śrīpūrvaśāstre ca srucamāpūrya sarpiṣā / kṛtvā śiṣyaṃ tathātmasthaṃ mūlamantramanusmaran śivaṃ śaktiṃ tathātmānaṃ śiṣyaṃ sarpistathānalam / ekīkurvañchanairgaccheddvādaśāntamananyadhīḥ tatra kumbhakamāsthāya dhyāyansakalaniṣkalam / tiṣṭhettāvadanudvigno yāvadājyakṣayo bhvet

source_text: [and]-abhinnācchivasaṃbodhajaladheryugapatsphurat / pūrṇāṃ kṣipaṃstattvajālaṃ dhyāyedbhārūpakaṃ sṛtam viśuddhatattvasṛṣṭiṃ vā kuryātkumbhābhiṣecanāt / tathā dhyānabalādeva yadvā pūrṇābhiṣecanaiḥ pṛthivī sthirarūpāsya śivarūpeṇa bhāvitā / sthirīkaroti tāmeva bhāvanāmiti śuddhyati jalamāpyāyayatyenāṃ tejo bhāsvaratāṃ nayet / marudānandasaṃsparśaṃ vyoma vaitatyamāvahet evaṃ tanmātravargo@pi śivatāmaya iṣyate / parānandamahāvyāptiraśeṣamalavicyutiḥ śive gantṛtvamādānamupādeyaśivastutiḥ / śivāmodabharāsvādadarśanasparśanānyalam tadākarṇanamityevamindriyāṇāṃ viśuddhatā / saṃkalpādhyavasāmānāḥ prakāśo raktisaṃsthitī śivātmatvena yatseyaṃ śuddhatā mānasādike / niyamo rañjanaṃ kartṛbhāvaḥ kalanayā saha vedanaṃ heyavastvaṃśaviṣaye suptakalpatā / itthaṃ śivaikyarūḍhasya ṣaṭkañcukagaṇo@pyayam śuddha eva pumān prāptaśivabhāvo viśuddhyati / vidyeśādiṣu tattveṣu naiva kācidaśuddhatā

## tal-a17-p12

source_text: [and]-ityevaṃ śuddhatattvānāṃ sṛṣṭyā śiṣyo@pi tanmayaḥ / bhaveddhyetatsūcitaṃ śrīmālinīvijayottare bandhamokṣāvubhāvetāvindriyāṇi jagurbudhāḥ / nigṛhītāni bandhāya vimuktāni vimuktaye etāni vyāpake bhāve yadā syurmanasā saha / muktāni kvāpi viṣaye rodhādbandhāya tāni tu ityevaṃ dvividho bhāvaḥ śuddhāśuddhaprabhedataḥ / indriyāṇāṃ samākhyātaḥ siddhayogīśvare mate śrīmān vidyāgurustvāha pramāṇastutidarśane / samastamantrairdīkṣāyāṃ niyamastveṣa kathyate māyāntaśuddhau sarvāḥ syuḥ kriyā hyaparayā sadā / dvyātmayā sakalānte tu niṣkale parayaiva tu īśānte ca pivanyādi sakalānte@ṅgapañcakam / ityevaṃvidhimālocya karma kuryādgurūttamaḥ purādhvani hutīnāṃ yā saṃkhyeyaṃ tattvavarṇayoḥ / tāmeva dviguṇīkuryātpadādhvani caturguṇām kramānmantrakalāmārge dviguṇā dviguṇā kramāt / yāvattritattvasaṃśuddhau syādviṃśatiguṇā tataḥ pratikarma bhavetṣaṣṭirāhutīnāṃ tritattvake / ekatattve śataṃ prāhurāhutīnāṃ tu sāṣṭakam
